metaDescription: Order custom UV400 sunglasses in bulk. Perfect for events and giveaways. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: UV400 lenses block 99-100% of UVA and UVB rays, providing the highest level of eye protection for your recipients. Whether you're outfitting a safety team or handing out promotional sunglasses at a summer event, choosing UV400 ensures your branded eyewear offers real value. Decorate with screen printing or pad printing on styles like the Aviator or Retro Sunglasses for a crisp, lasting logo.
heroAltText: Custom UV400 sunglasses with polarized lenses and logo imprint, ideal for outdoor promotional events
